mathematical_claim_policy: No exploratory result promotes an open Millennium obligation
selection_criteria: connection to an open proof obligation

experiments.title: Li-coefficient positivity and interval-ready normalization
experiments.hypothesis: Search for a positivity mechanism proving every Li coefficient lambda_n >= 0, not just finitely many numerical instances.
experiments.use_case: Numerically bracket the known first Li coefficient as a normalization check; full rigorous higher-n interval methods are not implemented.
experiments.falsifier: A rigorously negative Li coefficient at any index would refute RH; this initial positive numerical check does not certify any new index.
experiments.next_lemma: A uniformly rigorous positivity inequality for arbitrary n or an equivalent all-test-functions criterion.
experiments.missing_global_step: Prove positivity for every integer n without assuming the location of the zeros.

experiments.title: Tseitin parity contradictions and resolution proof complexity
experiments.hypothesis: Quantify how graph expansion forces refutation width and size in a specified restricted proof system.
experiments.use_case: Encode an odd-parity charge on the K4 graph as pure 3-CNF, then check unsatisfiability and construct a resolution refutation.
experiments.falsifier: Failure to verify a refutation or existence of a satisfying assignment invalidates this particular encoded example.
experiments.next_lemma: A correctly quantified expansion-to-width lower bound on an infinite bounded-degree graph family, within resolution.
experiments.missing_global_step: Restricted resolution lower bounds cannot alone establish P != NP, and do not prove a polynomial SAT algorithm.

experiments.title: Perturbative energy stability around a nonlinear ABC flow
experiments.hypothesis: Obtain controlled perturbation-energy estimates around the explicitly decaying ABC Beltrami solution, with all nonlinear cross terms accounted for.
experiments.use_case: Check the conditional L2 perturbation Gronwall factor using a global bound for the ABC velocity gradient.
experiments.falsifier: Any claimed universal stability bound contradicted by an explicit smooth perturbation or missing pressure cancellation must be rejected.
experiments.next_lemma: Provide a scale-critical a priori estimate or a logically complete breakdown construction for the official problem, not just L2 control around one flow.
experiments.missing_global_step: L2 stability conditional on smooth solutions does not prove their global existence, nor regularity for arbitrary R3 data.

experiments.title: Continuum-uniform transfer-matrix gap and reflection positivity
experiments.hypothesis: Determine precisely which reflection-positive spectral-gap bounds survive simultaneous infinite-volume and continuum limits in four-dimensional non-Abelian gauge theory.
experiments.use_case: Evaluate a two-state positive transfer-matrix toy where each regulator has a gap but the uniform lower bound vanishes.
experiments.falsifier: A toy gap that collapses along the regulator sequence blocks promotion of any finite-volume-only argument.
experiments.next_lemma: For SU(N) in four dimensions, construct a nontrivial continuum limit and a strictly positive mass bound in physical units, uniform in volume and cutoff, with axioms established.
experiments.missing_global_step: A two-state transfer model is not four-dimensional Yang-Mills and does not provide the required reconstruction.

experiments.title: Hyperplane-generated rational Hodge classes in controlled varieties
experiments.hypothesis: Identify geometric hypotheses under which every rational (p,p) class is generated by explicit algebraic cycles.
experiments.use_case: Verify the truncated cohomology ring and top pairing for projective space P^n as a known algebraic case.
experiments.falsifier: An exhibited rational Hodge class outside the image of the specified cycle map would falsify that restricted statement.
experiments.next_lemma: Extend a justified construction from the known variety class to genuinely new primitive rational Hodge classes, respecting all hypotheses.
experiments.missing_global_step: Projective-space calculations do not establish Hodge for arbitrary smooth projective varieties.

experiments.title: Descent, Selmer bounds and analytic-rank compatibility
experiments.hypothesis: For an explicitly declared family of elliptic curves, reconcile finite-field traces, descent/Selmer upper bounds, and analytic-rank information without hiding local factors.
experiments.use_case: Independently count points on y^2=x^3-x modulo several good primes, cross-check arithmetic and the Hasse bound.
experiments.falsifier: Any mismatch between independently computed local point counts invalidates the input data pipeline.
experiments.next_lemma: Supply precise analytic and algebraic rank/Selmer relations and the complete leading-term formula including Sha finiteness and local corrections.
experiments.missing_global_step: Local counts do not determine Mordell-Weil rank, analytic rank, Sha or a general BSD formula.

experiments.title: Independent proof reconstruction with topological sanity checks
experiments.hypothesis: Reconstruct and check the needed Ricci-flow-with-surgery lemmas and topology implications in a theorem-by-theorem proof ledger.
experiments.use_case: Verify mod-2 homology and Euler characteristic of the boundary of a 4-simplex, a known triangulation of S^3.
experiments.falsifier: Failure of the chain-complex identity or Betti-number calculation invalidates the finite topology example.
experiments.next_lemma: Check each relevant Perelman theorem and its precise hypotheses in a complete independent reconstruction.
experiments.missing_global_step: Correct S3 homology does not imply simple connectivity or the Poincare theorem; the conjecture was already proved externally.
